issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares Pneumatic.raisePressure(int) with return type void, but the provided solution declares Pneumatic.raisePressure(int) returning boolean. This mismatch will confuse students about the correct method signature and can cause compilation or test failures if they implement the interface according to the UML.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the Pneumatic.raisePressure(int) return type across artifacts. Either change the solution's Pneumatic.raisePressure(int) to return void to match the UML/problem statement, or update the problem statement/UML to specify a boolean return type and reflect that in the tasks and examples. Ensure LaunchedDropdownTower and LaunchedRollerCoaster method signatures are updated accordingly.
